# Workflows Instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` as canonical policy and `docs/PROCESS.md` session loop.

## Deluge/workflow rules

- Keep Deluge functions as full-function files.
- Make bounded edits tied directly to the active task.
- Do not introduce unrelated cleanup in workflow files.
- Keep naming, structure, and existing conventions consistent unless explicitly changed by task scope.
- Record verification evidence and open risks in handoff/PR context.

## Change control

- Do not deploy or mutate live Zoho systems unless explicitly approved.
- Treat workflow changes as controlled changes requiring clear reviewability.
